scope: Active2D contact and motion safety audit; no controller modification, training, Phase2 work, or Gate-2 benchmark

excludedEpisode.reason: Concurrent Worker-B offline pose replay externally changed probe transforms while Active2D was running, producing 0-32.787 mm trace deltas not attributable to the accepted 3 mm actuator actions. Excluded from actuator distribution, retained as evidence that trace acceptance does not detect external transform mutation.

staticFindings: Initial placement returns success only after FindSurfaceAt, AlignProbeToSurface, and EnforceRigidContact; workspace origin is then set to the achieved face-center position.
Cranial, caudal, medial, and lateral movement project onto the current tangent, find a new skin hit, align, enforce contact, reject teleport-like displacement, and check workspace.
Failed surface raycast occurs before transform mutation and returns false, but it is not separately counted or reason-coded in Active2D.
Rejected move restores old transform; its subsequent EnforceRigidContact return value is ignored.
Rotation checks contact and maximum contact displacement, but does not check workspace after rotation; rollback contact result is ignored.
Active2D phase handoff and final STOP use the privileged image evaluator but do not re-measure or gate on current contact/workspace.
Active2D overallPass does not include final contact/workspace and Active2DRunResult has no finalContactValid/finalWorkspaceValid fields.
Accepted Active2D movement has an upper discontinuity limit but no minimum achieved-displacement requirement.
Contact is validated at accepted discrete poses; no swept collision/contact proof establishes continuous skin contact between poses.
requiredBeforeGate2Approval: Add or independently verify explicit contact and workspace gates at PhaseHandoff and STOP.
Verify rollback EnforceRigidContact succeeds and record a distinct failure when it does not.
Record commanded and achieved displacement per action, including failed-raycast reason, and define a minimum-progress rule.
Run a small fresh bounded safety-only Unity fixture covering forced raycast failure, boundary rejection, rollback, rotation, handoff, and STOP before requesting the 40-episode Gate-2 benchmark.
